newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler hires real estate company - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler hires real estate company - WSJ.

text.p: Chrysler Corp has hired Equis Corp, a Chicago-based real estate firm, to improve the returns of its real-estate holdings, valued at $8 billion, the Wall Street Journal said in its Friday electronic edition.
Terms of the deal call for Equis to co-manage Chrysler's real estate portfolio, which includes manufacturing plants, offices and distribution centers worldwide, the report said.
The paper said details are still being finalized, but Chrysler hopes to cut costs and improve performance.
"We want to be more proactive in the management of our holdings," Chrysler's senior real estate speciallist, Jim Sproul, told the paper.
